description_template.template: [Stop/Never/Automatically] [specific pain point]. [This workflow] [does X, Y, Z]. [Perfect for/Result:] [specific outcome or industry].
examples: Stop manually copying email details into your calendar. This workflow runs silently every 15 minutes and detects meeting confirmations...
Never miss a payment event again. When Stripe fires a webhook - this workflow notifies all your channels simultaneously...
Automatically send a warm SMS reply when you miss a call. AI generates the message, Twilio sends it. Perfect for dentists, salons, clinics.
key_elements: 1. Hook: Start with a verb (Stop, Never, Automatically) + specific pain point
2. Mechanism: Briefly explain what the workflow does (1-2 sentences)
3. Outcome: Quantifiable result or specific industry applicability
4. Requirements: List API credentials needed (transparency = trust)
5. What's Included: JSON file, setup guide, video tutorial, documentation
6. Support: 30 days seller support, money-back guarantee
